title: PR 32434 - Remove labels from one stable selection
summary: Flow: Admin capability check to one selected-member snapshot to transactional relation removal. Repeated removals changed a label-based selection. Fix: select once, remove requested relations together. Batch 400 member IDs and 400 label IDs per lookup, keeping parameters bounded. Validate response counters; action may be absent.
validation_docs: 71 Core and 43 framework tests passed; 5 response cases repeated. Real SQLite rollback verified for 102 relations, with controlled selection. Browser, HTTP and MySQL not run; no production benchmark. Individual PR only.
